policy: Every current source field receives an explicit source disposition. This is not runtime semantic certification; semanticVerified/runtimeVerified remain false until producer-consumer and PostgreSQL evidence execute.

openCrossDomainInvariants.evidence: Current groups service exposes createGroup, attachProjectTeamGroup, transitionGroup and joinGroup as separate transactions.
openCrossDomainInvariants.requiredContract: One transaction-aware PROJECT_TEAM materialization operation must create/link/activate the team and validate/add all learner memberships so any failure rolls back the whole team. Reuse DB03 kernel; do not duplicate membership logic.

openCrossDomainInvariants.evidence: activity_events stores college_id plus string subject_id, but subject_id is not a relational project FK.
openCrossDomainInvariants.requiredContract: Project event creation must derive/persist project college scope and actor scope inside the same mutation transaction; forged cross-college project/actor combinations require negative DB/service evidence.
